name: Retention labels
short_description: Microsoft Purview labels applied to individual items such as documents or emails that define when retention starts, how long the item is kept and what happens at the end of the period.

evidence.quote: Retention labels are the rule book.
A retention label is an item-level rule attached to one specific piece of content such as an email or a document.
Retention policies and labels in Microsoft Perview are designed to help organizations retain content
